title: Ujde hue gharo se awaaz aa rahi
body:
Wawaila, hay wawaila.. Wawaila, hay wawaila..(2)
<<MINI>>
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
ab laut aa musafir..(2), Zehra bula rahi hai
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek saal yu guzara takti rahi mai raahein
bus dhundhti hai bhaiyya tumko meri nigahein
<<MINI>>
ab laut aao akbar..(2), sughra bula rahi hai
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mehendi lagaungi mai, sehra sajaungi mai
armaan hai ye maa ka, dulhan bulaungi mai
ab laut aao qasim..(2), farwa bula rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai aun aur Mohammed tum jin mein khelte the
suni hai ab wo galiya'n, weeran hai wo hujre
ab laut aao pyaaro'n..(2), dukhiya bula rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maa dhoop mein rahegi, faryaad bhi karegi
jab tak na aaoge tum, pani nahi piyegi
ab laut aao asghar..(2), mamta bula rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ummul baneen rokar ye kar rahi hai nauha
tum dasht e karbala mein, kulsoom par the fidya
<<MINI>>
ab laut aao ghazi..(2), behna bula rahi hai
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bus waris e ali se farhan aur mazhar
karte hai dil ki batein farsh e azaa bichakar
ab laut aao maula..(2), duniya bula rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Ujday hue gharo se aawaaz aa rahi hai..(2)
ab laut aa musafir..(2), Zehra bula rahi hai
